voice:
Hello, and welcome. I'm so glad you're here.
Take a moment and get comfortable — adjust your seat, let your shoulders drop. There is no hurry. We have all the time we need.
If you can, put on your headphones, and make sure you won't be interrupted for a while. This time is just for you.
Let everything else wait outside the door.
All you need to do now is settle in, breathe, and let your day grow quiet...
Every word draws you a little closer to the session, and soon we begin.
